## Career
- Google Cloud Delta — Staff Technical Deployment Lead (TDL), Delta (Jun 2026 — Present). Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) operating-model lead for 15 top-qualified enterprise accounts (including Ford and Intel); deal team capturing a $2B multi-year commit ($63M Google Services Funds, $5M Learning, $32M Partner Services Funds).
- Google Cloud AI — Outbound Product Manager, Gemini Enterprise App (20% rotation, Jun 2026 — Present). Led technical RFIs and live demos for 4 consecutive Google Cloud analyst Leader recognitions; GA launch of Agent Governance for Gemini Enterprise App.
- Google Cloud AI — Outbound Product Manager, GE Agent Platform & Gemini Enterprise App (full-time rotation, Dec 2025 — Jun 2026). Co-led Advent of Agents Seasons 1 & 2; co-authored the Executive "Intro to Agents" whitepaper for the Kaggle course (1.5M registered attendees); built AgentOps Cockpit.
- Google Cloud — Senior AI Consultant, Professional Services (PSO) (Jun 2023 — Dec 2025). 24 customer projects ($14.6M revenue, 100% CSAT); 21 customer deals closed ($11M); technical strategy for the NBC Paris 2024 Olympic Games chatbot (40M viewers, 90M queries).
- Google Cloud — Senior Data Consultant, Professional Services (PSO) (Jun 2021 — Jun 2023). Scaled the Boeing Analytical Platform from 1 to 29 tenants with a source-oriented mesh architecture.
- Amazon Web Services — Senior Cloud Architect, ProServe Public Sector (May 2020 — May 2021).
- Accenture — Senior Manager, Cloud Strategy & Data Analytics (May 2011 — May 2020). Led Disney+ global cloud scaling (100M+ users) and MyMagic+ (FastPass+ / MagicBands) product development for Walt Disney World.
